imageNote: No screenshots in this lesson, by design. GPU-enabled containers come down to a matching CUDA base image, the --gpus runtime flag, and the nvidia-smi diagnostic command — all Dockerfile/CLI content, not a product UI to capture honestly (GPU passthrough isn't something that renders as a screen). Every example (the CUDA base image Dockerfile, the --gpus flag, and the nvidia-smi verification command) is original, syntactically valid content checked against Docker's own GPU support docs and NVIDIA's Container Toolkit install guide.
